note: Nick's assigned priority countries as an analyst: Hungary and Slovakia (priority), Germany (secondary). Russia, Belarus and China are context countries (7.3): profiled for what they do to the eastern flank and to the three countries above, logged the same way, no baseline-requirement grid. The run appends dated facts to each country's log and keeps the profile current. Facts and summaries only; the item in the edition carries the So what. verified:false marks a fact to confirm against an official page.
blr: Continuity of government and critical services

countries.name: Hungary

gov.head: Péter Magyar
gov.title: Prime Minister
gov.majority: Tisza alone holds a two-thirds majority after the April 2026 election

nato.spend: 2.07% of GDP in 2025, down from 2.21% in 2024 (NATO estimates, March 2026)
posture: Croft training area used in the Spanish-led Strong Lineage 26 exercise, May to June 2026
Headquarters Multinational Division Centre at Székesfehérvár, activated on 3 May 2022 in the NATO Force Structure; it hosted the first conference of NATO's five MND commanders on 10 Sep 2025

stance.t: Magyar has said Hungary will deliver neither military vehicles nor lethal arms to Ukraine; first bilateral meeting with Zelensky in Brussels on 16 Oct 2026. On 10 Nov 2026 in Berlin he rejected tying the 2028–2034 EU budget to Ukraine aid and said borrowing to fund Kyiv is not acceptable for Hungary; humanitarian aid continues.
Foreign Minister Anita Orbán: Russia's current foreign policy is a risk; Hungary seeks a transparent bilateral relationship based on mutual interests.

Political agreement with the Commission on 29 May 2026 to release about €16.2–16.4bn (Recovery and Resilience Facility €10bn, rule-of-law cohesion funds €4.2bn, academic freedom €2.2bn); payouts follow the reforms, the first expected in the last quarter of 2026; Magyar said on 9 Nov the way to €16.4bn is open.

blr.t: Russian crude imports to end by October 2027, the government's stated deadline; gas still arrives via TurkStream through Serbia; the Economy and Energy Ministry ordered a financial review of the Paks II expansion in May 2026 and the government later proposed doubling its 2026 state financing. Merz offered German LNG on 10 Nov 2026; Magyar said the prices still have to be agreed.

First SMS-blaster case: a fake base station run from a car disrupted a commercial mobile network and sent fake police texts in July 2026; the operator's anomaly monitoring led the NNI to the car (disclosed 10 Nov 2026).

log.t: The National Assembly elected Péter Magyar prime minister; Tisza holds a two-thirds majority on its own.
Magyar held his first bilateral meeting with President Zelensky in Brussels.
src: Just Security: Hungary's election is already paying dividends

log.t: In Vilnius Foreign Minister Anita Orbán said a 2030 EU accession date for Ukraine is not realistic and Hungary does not support a fast track, while backing Ukraine's bid.
src: LRT (BNS): Ukraine's EU accession by 2030 unrealistic, says Hungarian FM in Vilnius

log.t: NATO ordered Hungarian Gripens to escort three airliners threatened with hoax bombs on 6 Nov, one Brussels–Sofia and two out of Prague; no device was found.

444: Néhány órán belül háromszor riasztotta a NATO a magyar Gripeneket utasszállító repülőket érintő bombafenyegetés miatt

log.t: Világgazdaság reported that Hungary withheld approval of the screening results for Ukraine's EU clusters 4 and 5 at the Council enlargement working group on 3 Nov, as on 20 and 27 Oct.
src: Világgazdaság: Orbán Anita nem a levegőbe beszélt: Ukrajna uniós csatlakozása

log.t: Prime Minister Magyar meets Chancellor Merz in Berlin on 10 Nov with the foreign, economy and energy, defence and interior ministers.
src: Index: Magyar Péter jövő héten Berlinben tárgyal Friedrich Merz német kancellárral
Ukrinform: Merz to discuss further support for Ukraine with Magyar

log.t: Foreign Minister Anita Orbán said on 7 Nov that Hungarian Gripens will fly Baltic Air Policing again in 2028, the fifth rotation.

log.t: Croatia's JANAF said the Adria crude pipeline, which also supplies MOL, was damaged during works on 6 Nov and the leak stopped.

log.t: Minister Kapitány said on 8 Nov that Poland and Czechia joined an expanded Central and Southern European energy coalition with Italy at a meeting in Zagreb; next round in Bucharest in about two weeks. JANAF said about 500 m³ of crude spilled from the Adria line near Prvča, with clean-up taking ten days.

log.t: In a German-language speech at the Konrad Adenauer Foundation in Berlin, Magyar said Europe must build real defence capability with NATO and its allies and that the government seeks a legal solution with the Commission this year to end the €1 million daily fine without weakening the southern border. [71]

log.t: On 10 Nov Merz and Magyar held the first German–Hungarian intergovernmental consultations in Berlin: Merz offered to sell Hungary LNG (Magyar said prices are still to be agreed), the two named air defence, fundable under the EU's SAFE loan, as the lead area of defence cooperation, and Magyar rejected tying the 2028–2034 EU budget to Ukraine aid or borrowing for Kyiv. Defence Minister Ruszin-Szendi met Pistorius and said Hungary is ready to take a larger role in Europe's conventional defence. [18, 63, 62]

countries.name: Slovakia

gov.head: Robert Fico
gov.title: Prime Minister
gov.majority: Smer-SD, Hlas-SD and the Slovak National Party hold 75 secure votes of 150 since MP Roman Malatinec left Strana vidieka on 3 Nov 2026; confidence vote won 18 Jun 2026

election.dateText: Parliamentary election due by late September 2027; Fico has floated a snap vote as early as January 2027
election.snapNote: Fico has floated a snap vote from January 2027

nato.spend: 2.0% of GDP in the 2026 budget, more than €2.88bn; government plan 3.5% by 2034
posture: Spain-led NATO Multinational Brigade at Lešť, Spain framework nation since July 2024 providing about 75% of the force; contributors include Slovakia, the Czech Republic, Portugal, Romania, Slovenia and Turkey
Parliament approved up to 101 soldiers for NATO's Eastern Sentry

stance.t: Fico said on 21 Oct 2026 that neutrality would suit Slovakia better and spoke of the alliance's 'false solidarity', while saying Slovakia honours its commitments.
No military aid from state stocks; commercial exports by Slovak manufacturers continue; Slovakia has announced it will not take part in new EU financial aid for Ukraine (dpa, 10 Nov 2026).
Opposes further sanctions packages that touch Slovak energy; gas arrives via TurkStream through Hungary.

blr.t: Gas supply depends on TurkStream flows through Hungary since Ukrainian transit ended; Druzhba crude via Ukraine remains exposed to strikes and transit decisions. Slovakia and Czechia have gas-storage agreements, have tested emergency diesel deliveries and are examining reverse oil flow through Druzhba, about €41m on the Czech side (Economy Minister Saková, 10 Nov 2026).

Joint Slovak–Czech procurement agreed on 10 Nov 2026: hardened large-capacity tanker engines, hardened personnel carriers, firefighting robots, flood and hazardous-material equipment, off-road vehicles and evacuation buses (Czechia buys eight items, Slovakia five).

log.t: The National Council expressed confidence in the Fico government.
In a televised debate Fico threatened snap elections if his coalition partners did not settle their dispute, suggesting January 2027.
src: Eurointegration: Why Slovakia could call snap elections

log.t: Fico said neutrality would suit Slovakia better than NATO's 'false solidarity'.
MP Roman Malatinec moved to Tomáš Taraba's party, leaving the coalition with 75 secure votes of 150; parliamentary votes were postponed to 10 Nov.
src: STVR: Koalícia prichádza o väčšinu: Roman Malatinec odchádza od Huliakovcov a pridáva sa k Tarabovej strane

log.t: At government consultations in Lviv Fico and Ukrainian PM Serhiy Koretskyi signed a joint declaration; Slovakia pledged €500,000 for 54 generators, €300,000 for shelters, €200,000 for hospital equipment and three locomotives.
src: Ukrinform: Koretskyi, Fico sign Ukraine-Slovakia cooperation agreement in Lviv
Interfax-Ukraine: Slovakia to provide Ukraine with generators and locomotives

log.t: The Commission's annual migration report, published 6 Nov, gave Slovakia no exemption from the 2027 solidarity pool; the Council decides by qualified majority.

log.t: Fico said on 6 Nov that the referendum of 2003 on joining the EU was falsified; he ruled out early elections before the 10 Nov votes.

countries.name: Germany

nato.spend: The defence ministry plans about €152 billion by 2029, to reach NATO's 3.5% core target that year, six years before the Alliance deadline (bmvg.de, 9 Sep 2026)
posture: Operationsplan Deutschland: the Bundeswehr's plan linking national and alliance defence with civil support, covering peacetime, hybrid threat, crisis and war
Host nation support: up to 800,000 allied troops and 200,000 vehicles must be able to move through Germany within six months (Bundeswehr)

Wehrdienst-Modernisierungsgesetz passed 5 Dec 2025: all 18-year-old men receive a questionnaire from January 2026; service stays voluntary with a compulsory fallback; 16,869 conscientious-objection applications 1 Jan–31 Oct 2026, against 3,879 in 2025 (BAFzA)

stance.t: Largest European supplier of military aid; Merz hosts the Coalition of the Willing in Berlin on 19 Nov 2026.
Germany is NATO's logistics hub; Joint Support and Enabling Command (JSEC) at Ulm; the Bundeswehr Joint Force Command runs host nation support as a whole-of-government task.

blr.t: Operationsplan Deutschland covers the military side only; civil defence sits with the Interior Ministry and the BBK; a reported €10bn civil-defence line by 2029 is not yet confirmed from an official source.
Host nation support planning assumes 800,000 troops and 200,000 vehicles in transit within six months; cost sharing between federal, state and municipal levels is still being examined.

log.t: The Bundestag passed the Wehrdienst-Modernisierungsgesetz in its final readings.
src: BMVg: Gesetzentwurf zur Modernisierung des Wehrdienstes

log.t: Defence Minister Pistorius named Lt Gen Christian Freuding the next Generalinspekteur from early February 2027, succeeding Gen Carsten Breuer, who becomes Chair of the NATO Military Committee in summer 2027.
src: Defense News (Reuters): Germany names Army Chief Freuding as next chief of defense
hartpunkt: Generalleutnant Christian Freuding wird neuer Generalinspekteur der Bundeswehr

log.t: Foreign Minister Wadephul pledged a further €200 million for Ukraine's energy, heating and humanitarian needs before travelling to Warsaw on 6 Nov.

log.t: Defence Minister Pistorius said about 190,000 soldiers serve, the most in 13 years, and that no conscription is needed if the trend holds.

log.t: Pistorius told the Funke papers on 7 Nov that the ministry counts about 38,500 applications this year, 24% more than a year earlier, and that troop strength passed 190,000 in early October; Röwekamp and Söder called for a return to conscription.
src: ZDFheute (AFP): Rückkehr zur Wehrpflicht: Pistorius sieht derzeit keinen Bedarf

log.t: The Bundesnetzagentur put German gas storage at 60.2% (149 TWh) on 6–8 Nov, well below past years, and rates the supply risk as low.

The Bundestag budget committee holds its final 2027 session on 12–13 Nov; the plenary vote is planned for 23–27 Nov. The defence ministry's draft gives about €110 billion plus about €30 billion from the special fund.
src: Haushaltsausschuss legt letzte Hand an Etat für 2027 (hib 906/2026)

countries.name: Russia

gov.head: Vladimir Putin
gov.title: President
gov.party: United Russia holds the State Duma majority
gov.majority: Fifth term began 7 May 2024, to 2030. United Russia won 349 of 450 State Duma seats in the 18–20 Sep 2026 election (140 list, 209 single-member), CEC chair Ella Pamfilova announced on 25 Sep; turnout 59.8%

election.dateText: Presidential election due March 2030; State Duma elected 18–20 Sep 2026

nato.spend: SIPRI estimate 7.5% of GDP in 2025, almost 16 trillion roubles; SIPRI puts planned 2026 military spending at 14.9 trillion roubles, 6.3% of GDP, after the 2026 budget law cut the national-defence line by more than 800 billion roubles from the 12.9 trillion draft. The 2027–29 draft budget went to the Duma on 30 Sep 2026 and passed first reading on 29 Oct, with 2027 spending of 48.7 trillion roubles; the explanatory note to the draft puts 2027 national-defence spending at 17.15 trillion roubles, about 35% of all spending, with only about 2.3 trillion in open budget lines
posture: Leningrad and Moscow military districts re-established by Presidential Decree No. 141 of 26 Feb 2024, in force 1 Mar 2024, facing Finland, the Baltics and Poland
Baltic Fleet and the 11th Army Corps in Kaliningrad
Northern Fleet and the Bastion in the High North; see the Arctic theatre
Non-strategic nuclear weapons stationed in Belarus since 2023; the Belarusian defence ministry said an Oreshnik unit “began performing combat duty tasks” on 30 Dec 2025 (the state's own words)

spend.src: SIPRI Military Expenditure Database, April 2026 release
spend.note: SIPRI estimate of military expenditure as a share of GDP; SIPRI revises past years, and NATO publishes no figure for Russia.

stance.t: Full-scale war since 24 Feb 2022; US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi on 10 and 11 Nov 2026 with Medinsky leading the delegation (see the board).
New START expired on 5 Feb 2026 with no successor treaty in force; Foreign Minister Lavrov said on 11 Feb 2026 that Russia will keep to the central limits as long as the US does.

Nuclear doctrine revised Nov 2024 to cover attacks by a non-nuclear state supported by a nuclear power; the Alliance named Russia the most significant and direct threat at the 2022 Madrid summit and has repeated it since.
Bank of Russia key rate 14.00%, held on 23 Oct 2026 for the second meeting running; next decision 18 Dec 2026.

gov.head: Aleksandr Lukashenko
gov.title: President
gov.party: No party; Belaya Rus is the loyalist party
gov.majority: Seventh term after the 26 Jan 2025 election; Prime Minister Alexander Turchin since 10 Mar 2025

election.dateText: Presidential election due by early 2030; House of Representatives elected Feb 2024, next due 2029

nato.spend: SIPRI estimate 2.4% of GDP in 2025, up from 1.4% in 2021
posture: Union State with Russia; Regional Grouping of Forces; Russian non-strategic nuclear weapons stationed since 2023; both defence ministries said an Oreshnik unit took up combat duty in Belarus on 30 Dec 2025

stance.t: Staging ground for the Feb 2022 invasion from the north; Lukashenko told Putin on 10 Nov 2026 that the Belarusian army and the Russian formations on the western direction were never sent to the combat zone in Ukraine (the state's own words, BelTA).
See the Kaliningrad line thread: the land link between Belarus and Kaliningrad crosses Lithuania and Poland.

log.t: Lukashenko sent condolences to the Polish people over the Kraków attack on 8 Nov; Lithuania's border guard turned back seven migrants at the Belarusian border in 24 hours.

gov.head: Xi Jinping
gov.title: General Secretary and President
gov.majority: Third term as General Secretary since Oct 2022; 21st Party Congress due autumn 2027

election.dateText: No national election; the 21st Party Congress is due in autumn 2027

nato.spend: Official defence budget 1.91 trillion yuan for 2026, up 7% (1.78 trillion, up 7.2%, in 2025); SIPRI estimate 1.7% of GDP in 2025
posture: Named by NATO a decisive enabler of Russia's war against Ukraine (Washington summit declaration, July 2024)
Joint naval and air patrols with Russia, including in the Arctic and the Baltic approaches; see the Arctic theatre
Taiwan Strait and ADIZ activity: see the Taiwan theatre and the ADIZ indicator

spend.src: SIPRI Military Expenditure Database, April 2026 release

stance.t: Largest Chinese investment destination in Central Europe: BYD began trial production at Szeged in late Jan 2026 and announced series assembly for the fourth quarter; CATL began trial cell production at Debrecen on 22 Sep 2026 (34 GWh in phase 1, 100 GWh planned); the Budapest to Belgrade railway is China-financed.

Strategic partnership agreed by Xi Jinping and Robert Fico in Beijing on 1 Nov 2024; Wang Yi and Foreign Minister Blanár met in Beijing on 10 Nov 2026, China is ready to extend visa-free entry for Slovaks by a year, and a Slovak firm signed memoranda with CGN and CNNC.
Germany's China strategy (July 2023) calls China partner, competitor and systemic rival; the Hamburg port terminal stake (COSCO 24.99%) stands.

Licensing for seven rare earths in force since April 2025; MOFCOM and customs Announcement 2026 No. 58 (9 Nov) keeps the October 2025 rare-earth and battery-materials package (2025 Nos. 55–58, 61, 62) suspended from 11 Nov 2026 to 10 Jan 2027; No. 72 suspends the US-only gallium, germanium and antimony ban until 27 Nov 2026; revised drone-item controls (Announcement 2026 No. 49 of 19 Oct) take effect on 18 Nov 2026.
